messages:
anna: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we agreed to reduce noise from the CPU autoscale alerts. putting proposed action items here so owners/times are clear.

javier: +1. can we summarize the recurring pattern again? helps set thresholds.

anna: pattern = short spikes on batch jobs between 02:50-03:20 UTC (daily), and occasional multi-host flaps when we rollout model bundles. pages are happening for 1-2min spikes, which are noisy. also some alerts duplicate across host and shard metrics.

mike: agree. proposal: 1) raise threshold on infra/cpu_high from 85% -> 92% for autoscale group metric; 2) add a 3m sustained window for paging; 3) dedupe by cluster+asg tag so we only page once per cluster.

sarah: sounds good. we should also add an exception for scheduled nightly batch run (02:45-03:30 UTC) — either silence rule via calendar or suppress alerts that correlate with batch job tag.

anna: owner assignments: 
- javier: implement dedupe key and correlation rule (cluster+asg), due Tue 2026-02-10 EOD.
- mike: change thresholds + sustained window in alerting rules and run through canary, due Mon 2026-02-09 midday.
- sarah: add calendar-based suppression for nightly batch windows and update runbook, due Tue 2026-02-10.

javier: noted. I'll update alert rule: 
```yaml
alert: HighCPU_AutoscaleGroup
expr: sum(cpu_percent{asg=~"redwood-.*"}) by (asg) / count(node_cpu_seconds_total) > 0.92
for: 3m
dedupe_by: ["cluster","asg"]
```
I'll post the PR to infra-alerts and tag ops.

mike: when you change the rule please include a fallback to page lower-priority channel for 3rd party infra so we don't miss real incidents. maybe route initial notifications to #infra-alerts and page #oncall only if sustained >10m or error rates rise.

anna: good call. add routing policy: page #oncall for sustained 10m OR if correlated errors metric (service.error_rate) > 0.5% in same window.

sarah: for runbook: I'll add a troubleshooting checklist and a short play for flapping during rollouts (how to mute and revert bundle). Also will add link to the PM that tracks rollout cadence.

mike: quick note on dedupe: we should avoid deduping across different services — ensure the dedupe key includes service_name where applicable so we don't hide cross-service incidents.

javier: updated plan: dedupe_by: ["cluster","asg","service_name"] where service_name exists. falling back to cluster+asg for infra-only metrics.

ops-bot: Incident summary posted: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-02-05-1684|INC-1684> — last 3 pages were during the 03:00 rollout window.

anna: please confirm ownership in this thread when you start work. i'll check PRs and mark the postmortem follow-up as in-progress in the action tracker.

mike: I'm starting the threshold PR now, will tag you @anna. target deploy to staging by today, canary tomorrow.

javier: I'll open infra-alerts PR and include test query and Grafana panel screenshots. assigning to @mike and @sarah for review.

sarah: opening the runbook ticket now (JIRA RED-2741) and adding calendar entry for nightly batch.

anna: thanks — i'll set a checkpoint in 48h to verify noise reduction metrics (pager volume by rule). if noise not down by 50% we'll revisit. :thumbsup:

mike: noted. will post before/after pager counts and a short blameless note.

javier: done for draft PR, link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/312

sarah: runbook ticket created: https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2741 — assigned to me, due 2026-02-10.

anna: perfect. closing the loop here — thanks team. we'll re-evaluate in 48h and update the PM action item. :white_check_mark:
